machine: amdR16 archived M6.4d timings only; no new benchmarks executed

definitions.owner_degree: number of internal LDU faces stored in each owner row
definitions.neighbour_degree: number of internal LDU faces whose upperAddr equals the cell
definitions.cache_line: psi is FP64; 64-byte aligned primary base; line=floor(cell/8)
definitions.actual_chunk_execution: main M6 width4 or M8 width8; terminal suffix uses safe M6 width4 helper; inactive terminal lanes use psi[0]
definitions.estimated_chunk_instructions: chunk instruction body only; outer loops/scatter excluded; inactive-slot equivalent is proportional allocation, not retired instruction count
